description: Create a water meter tracking spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/water_meter_tracking.xlsx to investigate a suspected leak. Track meter readings over 5 days (5/15-5/19/2024) with 7 total readings. Calculate usage differences and gallons-per-hour rates using formulas.
